positive_candidates.scope: Fixed positive couplings, homogeneous finite-range paired rotor/CAR law, exact modular physical Gibbs/ground states.
positive_candidates.assessment: Uniform cyclic coercivity and full-space Gaussian relative entropy avoid log N loss; local aliases vanish as N^-2 under actual modular support. Local normal subsequences for arbitrary joint L,N and beta cooling rates give integer Gauss stationary states and positive GNS generator. Fixed beta gives weak-representation KMS; fixed graph gives spectral ground convergence. No global any-alias, uniform g->0, phase, uniqueness or finite-payload inference.

positive_candidates.scope: Exact four-site two-particle ring, eta=(0,1,0,1), no magnetic plaquette, fixed eigenvalue index.
positive_candidates.assessment: Local Gauss connection removal produces constant commuting-band frame and charge variance 5/16. Scaled min-max precedes quasimode identification; coefficients [5/16-(2j²+2j+1)/128] and gap correction -1/32 follow. Smooth electric envelopes give leading S sqrt(g)->infinity recovery; polynomially stronger cutoff suffices for O(g³). Opposite S sqrt(g)->0 misses slow scale although floor can converge. No bulk mass or cubic phase.

positive_candidates.scope: Prescribed free analytic occupied-band trace with isolated untilted elliptic Weyl nodes and separated spectators; explicit paired Wilson arithmetic example.
positive_candidates.assessment: Fourier -norm cusp gives positive |R|^-4 coefficient, uniform energy expansion and node-hit exclusion. Degree-two subtraction supplies independent C2 control. Positive theta product yields diagonal-metric unique minimum; reflection stationarity and Hessian stability make alternating twists exact only for sufficiently large L=6m or6m+3. Four-cone multiplicity and pi sqrt(11)/2 free gap coefficient consistent. Local free correlations converge despite global twist alternation. Interacting reduction remains conditional at this stage.

positive_candidates.scope: Fixed connected graph, exact integer Gauss, connected flat torus, unique simple nondegenerate flat-matter minimum; all gaps/constants allowed to depend on box.
positive_candidates.assessment: Exact even normal ground and P/Q completion make normal matter correction O(g²), not O(g). Tangent Schur complement and bounded Berry terms give o(g) control. Strong rescaled compactness preserves multiplicities. Harmonic metric S=W_E/L additionally checked in actual integer cycle coordinates. Applies to preceding Wilson minima at each fixed sufficiently large L; limit g->0 FIRST then L->infinity only.

positive_candidates.scope: Same supplied full rotor/Wilson model, fixed a, untruncated rotors, g->0 at fixed L followed by L->infinity on declared subsequences; fixed supports and physical times.
positive_candidates.assessment: Ground-vector convergence plus strong translation/multiplier comparison gives physical bounded Weyl probes and neutral matter factorization. Separate positive energy-form convergence justifies two-field vectors; fixed-time Duhamel gives correlations. Curl covariance symbols vanish continuously at zero and Riemann sums give two-polarization free lattice Maxwell plus neutral Slater state. Does not identify fixed-g phase or arbitrary unbounded moments.

positive_candidates.scope: Strictly positive uniform diagonal electric/magnetic weights without magnetoelectric term; common prescribed diagonal Weyl metric.
positive_candidates.assessment: Axis necessity and cross-product sufficiency give W_E=c W_B for both photon polarizations everywhere. Matching family eta sqrt(detG)G^-1 and reciprocal eta gives exact quadratic lattice photon dispersion and leading Weyl cone equality. Weighted covariance and iterated-limit extension respect Gauss quotient. Positivity alone does not select the weights; unequal positive weights give a valid birefringent comparator.

positive_candidates.scope: Finite-volume untruncated elliptic rotor with smooth bounded CAR potential and full ground projection.
positive_candidates.assessment: Exact f-sums retain charged q² hopping and compact cos fluctuation terms. Flat external charge twist is physically unitarily absorbed; distinct from fixed internal holonomy and same-sign flavor twist. Degenerate-ground Ward identity and full-ground-space removal are sound. Massive London oscillator invalidates only static screening as a sufficient photon witness. Spectral Markov bound needs both inelastic weight and first moment; no pole or phase follows.

findings.detail: Keep finite positive-g regulator theorem distinct from fixed-box weak coupling and g->0-first iterated local state. Shared history terse limit-order language must not replace explicitly nested final equations; no simultaneous g(L), a->0, fixed finite payload, or positive-g phase statement is established.
